about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Over 20 years of insurance expertise
about.intro: Assurances Hefiri Zineb S.A.R.L. is an insurance brokerage firm founded in 2004 by Mrs. Zineb Hefiri. Based in Khouribga, we provide our clients with personalized advice and insurance solutions tailored to their needs.
about.mission_text: To offer our clients the best insurance solutions through expert, personalized and independent advice. We are committed to protecting what matters most to you: your family, your health, your assets and your business.
about.vision_text: To become the leading insurance broker in the Béni Mellal-Khénifra region and beyond, combining local expertise with international quality standards.
about.value1_text: Transparency and honesty in every client relationship.
about.value2_text: A qualified team with in-depth knowledge of the Moroccan market.
about.value3_text: Human and personalized support at every step.
about.value4_text: Quick and effective responses to all your requests.
about.history_text: Founded in 2004 in Khouribga, Assurances Hefiri Zineb S.A.R.L. has grown through client trust and a constant commitment to service quality. With over 20 years of experience, our firm has become a key player in insurance brokerage in the region.

services.title: Our Insurance
services.subtitle: Comprehensive solutions for all your needs

services.auto_guarantees: Third-party liability, All-risk coverage, Roadside assistance, Legal protection, Natural disasters
services.habitation_desc: Insure your house or apartment against everyday risks: fire, water damage, theft, natural disasters. Protect your assets and those of your family.
services.habitation_guarantees: Fire and explosion, Water damage, Theft and vandalism, Natural disasters, Tenant liability
services.sante_desc: Benefit from optimal health coverage for you and your family. Access to the best medical facilities in Morocco and abroad, with fast reimbursements.
services.sante_guarantees: Medical expenses and hospitalization, Medications, Maternity, Dental and vision care, Medical evacuation
services.voyage_desc: Travel with peace of mind with our travel insurance covering medical expenses abroad, trip cancellation, luggage loss and much more.

services.vie_desc: Prepare your loved ones' future with our life insurance contracts. Savings, provident and estate planning to secure your family's future.

services.entreprise_desc: Protect your business with our tailored solutions: professional multi-risk, corporate liability, fleet insurance and business asset coverage.
services.entreprise_guarantees: Professional multi-risk, Corporate liability, Fleet insurance, Legal protection, Business interruption

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions
faq.q1: What types of insurance do you offer?
faq.a1: We offer a wide range of insurance: auto, home, health, travel, life and business insurance. Each solution is tailored to your specific needs.
faq.q2: How can I get a quote?
faq.a2: You can get a free quote by filling out our online form, calling us at +212 5 23 49 26 22 or visiting our agency in Khouribga.
faq.q3: What documents are needed for auto insurance?
faq.a3: For auto insurance, you will need your ID card, vehicle registration, driver's license and driving history (claims record).
faq.a4: Our insurance covers the entire Moroccan territory. For travel insurance, coverage extends internationally depending on the plans chosen.
faq.q5: How do I report a claim?
faq.a5: In case of a claim, contact us immediately by phone at +212 5 23 49 26 22 or by email at hefiri@menara.ma. Our team will guide you through the process.
faq.q6: Can I modify an existing contract?
faq.a6: Yes, you can modify your contract at any time. Contact us to review your needs and adjust your coverage accordingly.
